summary: The V4 metadata sync notes for 19 October 2026 record a single item from Anoop Johnson: tight_bounds versus tight_stats as the way to represent stats tightness in V4. The group reached consensus on tight_stats, with the final naming still to be decided, and a spec pull request is being worked on. The notes add that the rules for aggregating the value at the manifest level also need to be covered.
